int_name: N HOLLY ST & SPRING GARDEN ST

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with mature trees and on-street parking. While sidewalks are present, the environment lacks marked crossings and features significant visual obstructions from parked cars and dense foliage.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and dense street-side vegetation significantly limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line where cars are parked and bushes are growing.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs are visible, which may lead to unpredictable crossing behavior.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate preferred crossing locations.

result.summary: The image shows a residential and institutional street environment with sidewalks on both sides and mature tree cover. While curb ramps with tactile paving are present, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks, and the sidewalk on the right is partially obstructed by debris.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Logs or construction materials are lying across the sidewalk on the right side of the image.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk near the stone building

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, which reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian crossings.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the left curb may obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style painted crosswalks to clearly delineate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection corners to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear the debris and materials currently blocking the pedestrian walkway on the right side.

result.summary: A narrow residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. The environment appears low-speed, but lacks marked crosswalks and has some sightline obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalks at the intersection reduces driver awareness of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the side street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: This is a two-lane residential street with sidewalks and mature street trees providing a buffer between pedestrians and traffic. While the environment is generally walkable, the presence of parked cars on the right creates potential sightline issues for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: A continuous row of parked vehicles on the right side of the street obscures the visibility of pedestrians to oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Mid-block Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: The long residential block lacks designated crossing points between intersections, potentially encouraging unsafe mid-block crossings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the far intersection to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the distant crosswalk with continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low and consistent with a residential environment.
